subject.title: Memory MVP: define SQLite schema and canonical record model

question: Should memory-core’s durable memory source of truth move from Markdown files to a plugin-owned typed SQLite record model for the MVP, and what migration/provenance/review contract must ship with that change?
rationale: The request defines persistent user state, status semantics, revision history, and upgrade behavior that source inspection cannot safely choose without maintainer product direction.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned SQLite MVP model
options.body: Define the v1 record/status/revision/provenance contract first, then implement the schema and migration boundary in memory-core.

options.title: Keep Markdown canonical for now
options.body: Leave SQLite as retrieval/index infrastructure and narrow or close this schema request once maintainers decide Markdown remains the durable source of truth.

options.title: Defer until memory convergence
options.body: Keep this as design backlog until maintainers choose the recommended memory plugin path called out in VISION.md.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned SQLite MVP model
recommendation.body: Define the v1 record/status/revision/provenance contract first, then implement the schema and migration boundary in memory-core.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the current memory storage and flush boundaries that this schema would replace or migrate.
